newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor futures market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor futures market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Bombay Oilseeds and Oils Exchange, which conducts futures trading in castorseed, was closed on Monday for a national holiday.

On Friday, castorseed June delivery initially dropped from 1,175/1,176 rupees to 1,168/1,169 rupees per quintal on slow overseas buying but later bounced back to 1,171/1,172 rupees on short-covering, traders said.
In edible oils, groundnut oil was steady at 358/359 rupees per 10 kg on a shortage of ready stock. s available at a lower
In Rajkot, spot groundnut oil was steady at 540/545 rupees per 10 kg.
